knowledge_point.title: Converting a Radical to a Unit Fraction Exponent

question.:question/worked-solution:
The radical $\sqrt[n]{x}$ can be written using a fractional exponent as ${x}^{1/n}.$

Comparing $\sqrt[n]{x}$ with $\sqrt[2]{2},$ we get $x=2,$ and $n=2.$ Therefore,

$$
\sqrt{2}=\sqrt[2]{2}={2}^{1/2}
$$
